description.text: Breif Introduction HUST offers a variety of master's degree and certificate options for the biotechnology professional and individuals interested in pursuing a career in the biotech field. Combining graduate courses in life sciences with management and business courses, HUST Biotechnology Graduate Programs are ideal for individuals interested in pursuing management opportunities within the industry. Why Biotechnology The biotechnology sector continues to be one of the fastest growing economic sectors in China creating new opportunities within the four primary sub sectors: I. Agricultural feedstock and chemicals II. Drugs and pharmaceuticals III. Medical devices and equipment and research IV. Testing and medical laboratories

duration.text: The Biotechnology at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Postgraduate school transcript Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Bachelor's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
